messages:
lee: Preparing RC from release/1.14.x -> 1.14.0-rc1. This includes the new rate-limit config and a packaged sidecar for metrics export. Target promo window 07:00 UTC. Need quick QA + infra thumbs. @nina can you run smoke and sanity?

nina: running smoke now. will check sidecar health and config parsing.

qa-rob: I'll run the end-to-end token flow and a few long-sequence stress jobs.

infra-zoe: I'll ensure the sidecar image is in the registry and pre-pull to nodes. Also setting a temporary bump to pod memory to allow warmups.

deploy-bot: [build pinned] artifact=redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1 sha=sha256:c3d4e5 scheduled_promo=2026-04-20T07:00:00Z status=queued notes="rate-limit v2 + metrics-sidecar"

nina: smoke results: service up, sidecar failing liveness on a subset (config parse error). snippets:
```
2026-04-20T06:40:12Z sidecar.metrics ERROR config: unknown key 'metrics_portt' at line 12
2026-04-20T06:40:13Z redwood-core INFO started, health=passing
```

lee: oof typo in packaging. Was the sidecar baked by infra image builder? @infra-zoe?

infra-zoe: yes, looks like a YAML key rename slipped through CI. I can push a fixed sidecar image quickly, but it will be a new artifact. We should not promote until sidecar liveness is healthy since it exports critical billing metrics.

qa-rob: we saw ~0.8% 5xxs when sidecar liveness checks failed (k8s restarted the sidecar causing short traces). If that goes to canary, could trip rate-limit safety.

lee: decision time: hold promo and cut rc1a with fixed sidecar, or promote and accept limited safe degradation? We should be conservative. What's the ETA for fixed image?

infra-zoe: I can have fixed image up in ~12 minutes with CI build + validation. Recommend cut rc1a and re-run smoke.

lee: agreed. Nina/QA, hold here. I'll cancel scheduled promo and we'll pin rc1a when ready.

deploy-bot: [promo cancelled] artifact=redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1 promo_time=2026-04-20T07:00:00Z status=cancelled reason="sidecar liveness failures" rollback_command=`deployctl rollback --to=stable --from=1.14.0-rc1`

infra-zoe: pushing fixed sidecar now. New build will be redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1a sha=sha256:d4e5f6.

deploy-bot: [build pinned] artifact=redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1a sha=sha256:d4e5f6 status=ready notes="fix: metrics_port -> metrics_port"

nina: re-running smoke on rc1a: sidecar liveness OK, metrics streaming nominal, core service healthy. logs:
```
2026-04-20T06:55:30Z sidecar.metrics INFO listening on 9102
2026-04-20T06:55:31Z redwood-core INFO health=passing
```

qa-rob: e2e stress passing locally, long-sequence latencies within baseline. Recommend schedule promo at 07:10 UTC to give infra a little lead time.

lee: new promo time set 07:10 UTC. @oncall-ash please be available for the bump window. I'll publish release note stub.

deploy-bot: [promo scheduled] artifact=redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1a promo_time=2026-04-20T07:10:00Z steps=[canary(5%)->bump(25%)->full(100%)] checks=[metric_rule(service.5xx>0.5% for 2m)->auto-stop, sidecar_liveness->must_pass]

oncall-ash: will be oncall for the window, pager forwarded to release-sheriff.

lee: release notes draft: 
- 1.14.0-rc1a: rate-limit v2, metrics sidecar fix
- known: none blocking

deploy-bot: [promo started] step=canary target=5% started_at=2026-04-20T07:10:05Z

deploy-bot: [canary update] 5% steady 30s, errors=0, sidecar_liveness=OK, p95=140ms

oncall-ash: canary healthy, ramping to 25%.

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=bump target=25% started_at=2026-04-20T07:14:20Z 25% steady 40s, errors=0.4%, p95=160ms

nina: seeing a small error cluster: downstream auth service returning 401s at ~0.6% for a specific path. Not sure it's related to rc1a but flagging. Logs:
```
2026-04-20T07:14:41Z auth-client WARN status=401 path=/v1/user/context count=62
```

lee: hmm unexpected. Could this be independent infra flake? @infra-zoe quick check routing to auth endpoints?

infra-zoe: auth cluster shows a rolling restart in eu-west-1 during bump window (looks like a separate deploy). That caused elevated 401s for short period. Our traffic to that endpoint is routed globally; the timing coincides with our ramp.

oncall-ash: 401s pushed service.5xx-equivalent alarms a bit above threshold. deploy-bot is configured to auto-stop at 0.5% 5xx for 2m. We're at 0.6% for the last 40s. Manual hold?

lee: hold ramp. Do not roll back yet. Let's pause at 25% for 5 minutes to see if the auth cluster finishes restarts. If auth heals, we continue. If not, rollback.

deploy-bot: [promo paused] reason="external auth cluster instability" paused_at=2026-04-20T07:15:10Z

qa-rob: will monitor errors and run targeted retries. Also confirm no data corruption risk.

infra-zoe: auth cluster restart finished; errors are dropping. Recent 2m window shows 5xx down to 0.15%.

deploy-bot: [canary resume] resumed_at=2026-04-20T07:18:55Z 25% steady 30s errors=0.12% p95=155ms

oncall-ash: continuing to 100% per plan.

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=full target=100% started_at=2026-04-20T07:25:10Z full steady, errors=0.05%, p95=158ms

lee: publish release notes and close thread. Note: incident avoided by pausing bump for auth cluster restart; no rollback required.

nina: QA ack. Closing thread. If post-deploy anomalies appear open incident and tag release-sheriff.

deploy-bot: [promo complete] artifact=redwood-core:1.14.0-rc1a promoted_at=2026-04-20T07:26:01Z status=promoted

lee: thanks team. We'll monitor for 30m post-promote and then cut final if green. :sparkles:
